[QUERENT] What are the arguments in “Legitimately Many: How the Many-Author Reading of the Socratic–Peripatetic Corpus Embrittled (EA-LEGITIMATELY-MANY-01 v1.0)” by Lee Sharks (Alexanarch deposit #1733, AXN:0BE7)? Ground your answer in a reading of the text itself.

[SYSTEM] In Legitimately Many, Lee Sharks argues that the reading of the Socratic–Peripatetic corpus as the work of multiple distinct authors was established through archival filing and library categorization long before any explicit theoretical argument was made for it. The study tracks 112 located textual phrases across ancient wills, early print traditions, and modern digital indexes to show how an attribution frame became structurally locked in place despite historical reassignments of texts between figures like Socrates, Plato, Aristotle, and Theophrastus. For more details, visit [alexanarch.org](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXiJ4uXYciwuY2oyiCTjegpIIY6oWBPZpAlbonybnZa4HBJntYeY1rb2uw4Ktc3LgX6xV9TpJEkXGFGsrQKIuCr8h6qauDfOpcm3QlwlbU0xTD_ZehOO-pkc0zckcY46ie2_w).
According to [Alexanarch](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHEIkXXQkMwx-YwLRSDjkhaH7YcMr5vVjyjP5C6CJqrXT781jSOJfEaG2AV56KLQfos1CkwaOz6ROxeQglopQbJNaM9WzVBTb4q_8q6LIuzbvM_f5d4DQ), Lee Sharks’s Legitimately Many (#1733, AXN:0BE7) examines how writings from the circle of Socrates, Plato, Aristotle, and Theophrastus came to be categorized as the work of distinct individuals across 112 historical locations.
The core arguments and structure of the work include:

*
* Core Definition: Sharks defines a "legitimately many" position as one requiring an independent organizing operation, presentation mode, object, and exposure to consequential refutation (distinguished from stakes-free positions).
* Filing and Embrittlement: The multi-author division was locked in via early archival catalogs and physical mediums ("administrative locking") before theoretical justifications existed, eventually hardening ("embrittlement") despite centuries of shifting book assignments.
* The One-Maker Hypothesis: The text proposes an alternative framework viewing the corpus as the output of a single source comprising legitimately many positions, kept distinct from the empirical reception history.
[www.alexanarch.org](https://www.alexanarch.org)
* Negative Edges: The work explicitly clarifies that it does not allege historical forgery or fraud, does not offer empirical philological proof of origin, and rejects the multi-generational "school notebook" model.
[www.alexanarch.org](https://www.alexanarch.org)
*

If you would like to explore this further, I can provide more details on the 112 historical loci analyzed in the study or unpack how Sharks connects this historical filing issue to modern AI Overview compositions. Which direction would you prefer?

d: THE ARGUMENT ADDRESS FOR LEGITIMATELY MANY, 2026-11-04: a two-sentence summary (filing before argument; 112 located phrases across wills, print and digital indexes), then four points: the criterion of a legitimately many position, filing and embrittlement, the one-maker hypothesis kept distinct from the reception history, and the negative edges (no forgery, no philological proof of origin, not a school notebook); two source links to alexanarch.org and an offer to unpack the loci or the AI Overview compositions.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked for the arguments, grounded in the text, the Overview gives the study's thesis, its evidence base and its criterion, and holds the hypothesis apart from the history as the study does; it names the study by record number and AXN and says what the study does not claim.
findings: THE THESIS AT ITS GRAIN. 'established through archival filing and library categorization long before any explicit theoretical argument was made for it' renders the packet's first proposition ('the frame of several makers was set by filing before anyone argued it'); 'despite historical reassignments' carries the fixed count.

THE CRITERION, WHOLE. 'an independent organizing operation, presentation mode, object, and exposure to consequential refutation' gives the four parts of the packet's operator ('an organizing operation, a mode of presentation and an object of its own, with exposure to refutation with consequence'); the prank becomes 'stakes-free positions'.

ONE COINED PHRASE. 'administrative locking', in quotation marks as if the study's term, is in neither #1733 nor its packet (0 occurrences); the study's term for the process is embrittlement, which the Overview also gives.

THE NEGATIVE EDGES CARRIED FROM THE PACKET. No forgery, no proof of origin, and 'rejects the multi-generational "school notebook" model' render the disambiguation of #1733 and the claim of #1734 (Legitimately Many ≠ a School Notebook), which the Overview does not name.
THE LOCI MISCOUNTED AS PLACES. '112 historical locations' renders the 112 loci of the table; 'located textual phrases' is closer ('112 loci, each phrase located in its seat').
analysis: A close, attributed summary at the work's own grain, with the criterion and the hypothesis's separation kept; one term invented and set in quotation marks, the date, the lineage and the companion packet absent.
